related.title: XMM-Newton X 射線天文台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件篩選、曝光、背景處理與光子通量，不誤標能量通量。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver event cuts,exposure,background treatment and photon flux without mislabelling it energy flux.
related.difference: 從高背景時段剔除不適用資料，計算好時間區間與有效計數率。
related.differenceEn: Remove unsuitable high-background intervals and calculate good-time exposure and count rate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算曝光 10⁷ cm²s，再以淨事件數除以曝光，與每秒計數率比較。
刪第三段後同時重算事件和秒數，與錯用 400 s 的結果比較。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute exposure 10⁷ cm²s,then divide net counts by exposure and compare with count rate.
Remove the third bin and recompute counts and seconds,comparing with the wrong 400 s denominator.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Cassini-Huygens 土星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件篩選、曝光、背景處理與光子通量，不誤標能量通量。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver event cuts,exposure,background treatment and photon flux without mislabelling it energy flux.
related.difference: 設計探測資料收集、緩衝與中繼的時序帳，檢查輸入輸出速率不匹配。
related.differenceEn: Design a probe-data acquisition,buffer and relay ledger and test mismatched input/output rates.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算曝光 10⁷ cm²s，再以淨事件數除以曝光，與每秒計數率比較。
算前段 3.6 Mbit，再算後段淨增 2.4 Mbit，與總量式核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute exposure 10⁷ cm²s,then divide net counts by exposure and compare with count rate.
Compute 3.6 Mbit before relay and 2.4 Mbit net increase afterward,checking the total formula.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
